name: Los Angeles Math Circle (UCLA)
what_it_is: Weekly session handouts of the Los Angeles Math Circle, run by the UCLA maths
department. The archive covers 2007 to 2026, one page per year, and every page
lists its sessions with the handout PDFs attached. The other 21 pages of the site
hold no problem files at all, so the archive is the whole source.

scale.years: 2007-2026 (the 2026 page is live but missing from the year menu)

groups.Advanced: US grades 9-12, the richest pool and the one that reaches Terminale
groups.Intermediate: US grades 7-8, largely AMC 8 style contest problems
groups.Beginners 2: US grades 5-6, mostly below 4e, take only what reaches it

note_on_access: ucla.edu does not resolve through this machine's DNS (SERVFAIL), although public
